mapper.select: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.return_rate DESC) AS `rank`, r.participant_id AS participantId, p.nickname AS nickname, r.final_asset AS finalAsset, r.return_rate AS returnRate, r.persona_id AS personaId, pa.persona_name AS personaName FROM event_game_results r JOIN event_participants p ON p.participant_id = r.participant_id LEFT JOIN personas pa ON pa.persona_id = r.persona_id WHERE r.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY `rank` ASC, p.nickname ASC, r.participant_id ASC
